title: epan: Add masked plaintext export support
description: Adds address masking capabilities to the Qt Export Dissection dialog (`export_dissection_dialog.cpp`) and the plaintext print engine (`epan/print.c`).

Please stop to mark all comments as resolved while you have it addressed any of them.

_@pquantin My apologies for resolving those threads prematurely—I misunderstood the review process and thought resolving them was expected after pushing the fixes. I won't mark threads as resolved myself going forward._

_To address your code feedback directly:_

1. _`packet-trdp.c` changes have been completely removed._
2. _Deleted comments, `#if` macros, and formula handling in `epan/print.c` have been fully restored._
3. _`mask_addresses` default is set to `false` and moved out of C Arrays into the main `print_args_t` struct in `file.h`._
4. _Regarding address masking logic: If the core team prefers a persistent per-address randomized mapping over a fixed mask for plaintext export, I am happy to submit that in a follow-up MR or update this branch based on your guidance._

_Thank you for your patience and for reviewing_

You should review your changes before pushing: for example mask_addresses is still set to true (with no way to change the value) and most of the review comments were not addressed (formulas removed, ifdef added, etc).

Honnestly I do not see the usefulness or this merge request, especially when all addresses are changed to the same dummy value. It makes the output unusable IMHO.
